summary.dropped_note: All-companies list: no employee cap; ranked 12-month UK/Ireland marketing, consulting and commercial first (top 20). Under-20k list: dropped group/parent headcount above 20,000 (TUI, NBCUniversal, Cummins, Aon, EY, Carlsberg, Samsung). Haleon and L'Oréal UK IPs closed 23 Oct. Mercedes-AMG F1 business-support IPs still not live (hub says November). HPE UKIMEA comms placement, Stanley Black & Decker Maidenhead RFIs, and 6-month FR/CH stages (Danone RGM, Nespresso CX, Berluti CRM, Dior Geneva) ranked out of the all-companies top 20. MyFuture stays Maya-manual.
